name: [UPD 7] Magic RNG
desc:
🌌 Welcome to Magic RNG! 👋

🍀 Roll to obtain auras!
💫 Magic RNG features various auras! Rolling gives you a chance to obtain super cool rare auras!
🧙🏻 Use auras to craft unique wands for better luck and reduced roll cooldown!
⬆️ Potions are located on the map! Be sure to pick them up for extra luck!
🏝️ There are various different random weather conditions! With these there are a greater chance to roll weather-exclusive auras!
😎 Play with friends, both of you will get extra luck bonuses. Let's see who has the best luck! 

🆕 The new Free Limited UGC Event has begun! Roll for a specific aura to redeem a beautiful UGC accessory for free!

💫 We've added a dazzling new aura!

Tags: Aura, RNG, Roll, Luck, Rarity, Multiplayer, Magic
